title: Douglas Emmett to Present at 2026 Citi Global Property CEO Conference
summary: Douglas Emmett, Inc. (NYSE: DEI), a real estate investment trust (REIT), announced today that Chairman and CEO Jordan L. Kaplan will be participating in a roundtable discussion at the 2026 Citi Global Property CEO Conference on Tuesday, March 3, 2026 at 10:15 am Eastern Time. A live webcast of the discussion will be available at: https://kvgo.com/citi/douglas-emmett-march-2026 A replay of the discussion will be available on the same URL starting twelve hours after the end of the live event and continuing for one year. About Douglas Emmett, Inc. Douglas Emmett, Inc. (DEI) is a fully integrated, self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust (REIT), and one of the largest owners and operators of high-quality office and multifamily properties located in the premier coastal submarkets of Los Angeles and Honolulu.
